title: Click Game
description: Pick animals, objects, letters or numbers and click the colorful symbols that pop up across the screen in this endless free browser clicker.
about:
Click Game is a simple, endless clicker with a cheerful blue background. Before you start you choose what you want to click: animals, everyday objects, letters or numbers. Symbols then pop up at random spots in random colors and angles, and every one you click shrinks away and adds a point to your score.

The fun is in the rhythm. Each click spawns a growing burst of new symbols until the screen is full, then the flood pauses while you clear the board, and the cycle starts again. A timer counts how long you have been playing, and every 50 points the game politely asks if you want to stop or keep going.

There is no way to lose, which makes it a relaxing way to pass a few minutes, a handy mouse or touch warm-up, and an easy first game for young kids learning letters and numbers.
howToPlay: Press Play, then choose Animal, Object, Letter or Number. Click or tap the symbols as they appear to score a point for each one. The game never ends on its own: every 50 points you can choose Yes to stop and return to the start screen, or No to keep clicking.

controls.action: Pop a symbol and score a point
Choose a category and answer Yes / No

tips: Clear symbols near the edges first so the middle stays easy to reach.
Every click early in a cycle spawns more symbols, so expect the screen to fill up fast.
Letters and numbers make a nice recognition game for kids: call out each one before tapping it.
Pick No at each 50-point checkpoint to see how high you can push your score and time.

faq.question: Is Click Game free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. It is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Does it work on phones and tablets?
faq.answer: Yes. Just tap the symbols instead of clicking; on small phones the symbols are smaller, so it takes a steadier finger.

faq.question: Does the game ever end?
faq.answer: No, it is endless. Every 50 points it asks whether you want to stop, and choosing Yes resets the score and timer.
